description: Waste and recycling — Bin Collection Calendar is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council residential bin collection calendar for red, yellow and green bins along with the corresponding suburbs kerbside large item collection week. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are bin, calendar, collection, community, day. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
